entries.title: LM61460 pour-aware effective RthJA (58.7 -> 35 C/W)
entries.assumes: full-board In1.Cu GND plane + per-buck thermal-via field (>=6 x 0.6/0.3) at PGND1/PGND2 + local F.Cu/B.Cu GND pours (TI SNVSBD5D 7.3 bare 58.7 C/W vs 25 C/W on a 4-layer board; 11.1.1 layout)
entries.emits: In1.Cu GND plane: NO;
entries.risk: without this copper Tj(power:U1, 2.42 W) backs out to ~192 C at the bare 58.7 C/W against the 140 C guard — a board-dead thermal PASS-on-fiction (the GAP1 CRITICAL). The thermal gate now HARD-verifies this copper per build.

entries.title: TLV75725 DYD EP thermal-pad RthJA (92.5 C/W)
entries.assumes: DYD thermal pad soldered to GND copper + JESD51-5 pad-adjacent thermal vias into the buried plane (the DS DYD RthJA ~92.5 C/W is DEFINED on that stackup; without it the gate falls back to the DBV bare 231 C/W)
entries.emits: In1.Cu GND plane: NO;
entries.risk: at the no-copper fallback 231 C/W the VADJ LDO (fmc:U1, 320 mW) lands Tj ~124 C over its 115 C guard — the PWR-3 package swap's entire benefit rides on this copper

entries.title: TPS26631 PWP 2s2p RthJA (33.6 C/W)
entries.assumes: HTSSOP-20 PowerPAD EP soldered to copper with thermal vias into a buried plane (TI SLVSE94 RthJA ~33.6 C/W is the JEDEC 2s2p figure — it presumes internal planes)
entries.emits: In1.Cu GND plane: NO;
entries.risk: low today (Pd ~54 mW -> huge margin even at several times the 2s2p figure), but the basis string was still plane-predicated while no plane existed

entries.title: CHASSIS_GND island + single-point GND bond
entries.assumes: a CHASSIS_GND copper island (connector shells + mounting ring) joined to signal GND at EXACTLY ONE point (bonding pad / 0R / via stitch near power entry)
entries.emits: CHASSIS_GND board-level copper: 0 zones, 0 vias (pads only otherwise); no bond stitch emitted
entries.risk: fab'd as-is the shields/mounting ring have NO DC reference (ESD return path open) — ERC/DRC cannot see it because the single-point bond is deliberately not netlisted

entries.title: Bob-Smith trunk copper (BS_COMMON island)
entries.assumes: a Bob-Smith common trunk (4 x 75R || 1n/2kV into BS_COMMON) laid in copper on the chassis-side island, spaced for the 2kV surge rating (IEEE 802.3 40.7.1)
entries.emits: BS_COMMON board-level copper: 0 zones, 0 vias (pads only)
entries.risk: without trunk copper + spacing the 2kV HF termination exists only as parts; surge creepage and return-path behaviour are unproven until the routing wave draws the island

entries.title: Ethernet isolation moat (In1 plane voids)
entries.assumes: NO GND plane under the ethernet magnetics line side / RJ45 media pins (Pulse HX5008 layout guidance; the 2kV isolation moat) — the full-board In1 plane must be VOIDED there
entries.emits: In1 rule-area voids: none; corridor between them: NOT voided (debt)
entries.risk: a continuous plane under the magnetics bridges the isolation barrier capacitively and violates the 2kV creepage intent; the RJ45<->magnetics media CORRIDOR void remains routing-wave debt

entries.title: DP90/DP100 L2 reference plane
entries.assumes: the DP90_USB / DP100_TMDS trace geometry (widths/gaps in the .kicad_dru + net classes) is an OUTER-layer microstrip referenced to a CONTINUOUS L2 GND plane through one 7628 prepreg sheet
entries.emits: no GND fill zone on In1.Cu
entries.risk: without the L2 plane every impedance number in the dru is unmoored (return path undefined, impedance wrong by design); with the plane emitted the residual risk is fill VOIDS/splits under a future route path (checked at the routing wave)

entries.title: Under-SoM decoupling fanout vias
entries.assumes: the under-SoM bottom-side rail-entry decoupling (som_decoupling) reaches the rails/planes through fanout vias directly beneath the DF40 mezzanine
entries.emits: GND vias inside the SoM body zone: 0 (SoM zone NOT found); rail fanout vias: none emitted
entries.risk: until those vias land the 18 bottom caps decouple nothing (no path from B.Cu pads to the rails) — a routing-wave item, but the prose reads as if the path exists
